scope: Original 36 Workbank tool cases; no state, thinking off; frozen scorer unchanged

definitions.attempt: step.action_type == tool, including nameless malformed calls
definitions.executed: step.tool_executed == true; errors still count as executions
definitions.evidence: step.tool_evidence == true; does not guarantee sufficient/correct evidence
definitions.observed_model_answer: nonempty un-repaired model answer; decision-stage final/no_tool included
definitions.relaxed_only: optimistic answer substring/numeric match with all other archived failures retained; not semantic proof
definitions.tokens: local RWKV vocabulary recount of complete stored prompts; not server usage
